messages.content:
You are proposing scientific conjectures. A conjecture is a bold, specific,
falsifiable claim or approach -- not a summary, not a plan, and not a hedge.
Write plainly.

Construct a configuration of 13 points in the unit square achieving the largest minimum triangle area you can; the score is the smallest area among all 286 triangles formed by triples of your 13 points, every point must lie in [0,1]x[0,1] and all 13 points must be distinct.

Stay within this direction: two concentric rotated sub-clusters with area gap tuning

Propose ONE conjecture in response, within that direction.
Output exactly one JSON object and nothing else:
{"conjecture": "<2-4 sentences>"}

message.content: {"conjecture": "The optimal configuration consists of two concentric rotated clusters: an outer cluster of 8 points arranged on the boundary of the unit square (two per edge, symmetric about each edge midpoint), and an inner cluster of 5 points arranged on a circle of radius r≈0.62 centered at (0.5,0.5), rotated by π/10 relative to the outer square's symmetry axes. The inner radius r is tuned so that the minimum-area triangle—formed by two adjacent outer points and one inner point—equals the minimum-area triangle formed by three inner points, yielding a largest achievable minimum triangle area of approximately 0.0245. The rotation by π/10 ensures no three points are collinear and balances the gap between outer and inner clusters to maximize the bottleneck area."}
